AppRoles.Description: What a signed-in person may be. A person's AppRole points here; policies ask app.has_role('<AppRoleId>'). Added by the effortless-magic-links seed because the project had no roles of its own.

schema.name: AppRoleId
schema.Description: The role's key, as policies name it: admin, member, ...

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: How the app shows the role.

data.Title: Admin
data.Description: Sees and changes everything, manages who may sign in.
